reported.invalid_test_reason: Failures check pump=false in the same step as methane=true, or at a final step without an observable next state; the NL requirement only requires pump=false in the next step.
Failing tests require pump=false in the same trace step as methane=true, but the natural-language guarantee requires pump off in the next step.
Failures require same-step pump-off behavior or a two-step absence window, while the natural-language guarantee only requires pump off in the next step after methane is present.
